summary: First-Experience Wave frontend regression test on preview. Ran fresh signup → dashboard → first-chat → day-2 return, plus admin sidebar & notification bell verifications, plus code-level verification of all 3 rollback surfaces, copy/jargon changes, and TaskProgressCard rollback_failed state. All primary acceptance criteria PASS. No native window.confirm() remains in the 3 rollback surfaces. Non-admin fresh signup correctly hides Tools/Developer-tools section. The specific 'approve button didn't load' false-positive warning does NOT appear on a plain first-chat Q&A. Chat history persists across logout/login. Notification bell shows unread count (5), SHIP FAILED (error-severity) items in dropdown.

minor.issue: One-off RuntimeError('No response returned.') seen for GET /api/aurem-dev/loop/active during test — Starlette BaseHTTPMiddleware ended stream. Pre-existing, unrelated to today's changes.

backend/.env has MOCK_LLM=true but backend logs show real LiteLLM/OpenRouter/DeepSeek calls during chat_stream (e.g., '🟠 Root cause: missing authorization header' first-attempt mismatch triggered a low-confidence suppression fallback). Not blocking (chat still returns a canned fallback), but MOCK_LLM does not appear to actually short-circuit /chat/stream. Worth confirming this env flag is wired into the stream path.

integration_issues.issue: The first assistant reply after fresh signup came back as the low-confidence fallback: '⚠ low confidence — response suppressed / I couldn't find a confident answer to that — try rephrasing, or ask again. · via ORA'. Content is expanded (good) and no false 'approve button didn't load' banner (good — the fix works). But the founder-facing 'clean, helpful' first-reply target isn't actually met because the mismatch-retry path in routers/chat.py silently converted a normal Q&A into 'low confidence' suppression. Recommend either (a) fixing MOCK_LLM to actually deterministic-mock the first-turn reply, or (b) softening the mismatch-detection threshold on the very first chat_stream turn for a brand-new user (no repo yet, no council recall — it should never trigger a mismatch).

issues: On desktop (1920) and mobile (390) viewports, the sidebar renders as an icon-only rail (RailShell — rail-icon-chat/ship/insights/settings/admin). The full expanded sidebar variant with the 'Tools / Developer tools' accordion (SidebarBound.jsx lines 515-590) was NOT reachable via any interactive button (rail-autohide-toggle just toggles autohide, doesn't expand). So we could NOT visually confirm the admin-positive case ('admin/founder SHOULD still see Tools'). Code review confirms the isAdminOrFounder(user) gate is correct, and the non-admin negative case is confirmed hidden. Main agent should verify how/where admins are supposed to see the Tools accordion in the actual DS2 shell.

action_items: Investigate why MOCK_LLM=true is not actually mocking chat_stream — real DeepSeek/LiteLLM calls fire and the mismatch-retry logic can suppress the first reply into a 'low confidence' fallback for a brand-new user with no repo. This makes the first-chat experience feel broken even though technically no fix was proposed.

Clarify (or add a screenshot spec) for where the admin sidebar 'Tools' accordion is supposed to render in the DS2 shell. Non-admin hide is correct; admin visibility path was not manually verifiable in this run.
P2-A notification bell verified live: 5-badge, dropdown shows SHIP FAILED (error severity) plus SHIPPED/SCAN — matches design. No live action needed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://bin-context-pat.preview.emergentagent.com. Non-admin Tools hide fix is confirmed live. All 3 rollback surfaces use the themed RollbackConfirmModal (verified in code; no window.confirm remains). The one soft finding is the first-chat reply landing on a 'low confidence — response suppressed / I couldn't find a confident answer' fallback instead of a clean helpful reply — root cause: MOCK_LLM=true in backend/.env but chat_stream still hits the real LLM + mismatch-retry path, which suppresses the first turn. If main agent wires MOCK_LLM into routers/chat.py chat_stream, this first-experience issue would fully resolve. Notification bell fully working. Day-2 chat history persistence works.
rca of the issue: First-chat 'low confidence — response suppressed' RCA: routers/chat.py chat_stream mismatch-detection fires on the very first turn for a brand-new user with no project connected. Reproduction: fresh signup → send 'What can you do for me?' as first message → reply comes back as the low-confidence fallback template. Mitigation: gate the mismatch retry/suppression path so it only runs when (a) a project is connected AND (b) council_recalled > 0, OR make MOCK_LLM=true actually deterministically mock the chat_stream response (currently it appears to only affect other LLM entrypoints).
